Title: Wearable Type Series
Description: "Designed and created 26 sterling silver rings, each shaped like a letterform. Designed to be worn in multiple orientations and connect identity to form through tactile, wearable typography."
Awards: Awarded GCAC: Funds for Artists grant

Title: Jewelry Typeface
Description: "Designed a custom typeface inspired by the geometry of a Wearable Type Series. Designed for future use in branding, packaging, and digital marketing."

Title: Custom Star Rings
Description: "Designed and handcrafted a series of star-shaped rings"

Title: Learning Metalsmithing
Description: "Learned the basics of metalsmithing rings with a variety of techniques like soldering, dapping, and stone setting."

Title: Algorithmic Textile Design
Description: "Programmed a knitting machine to play around with textures, tension, and patterns. Used with CMU Textiles Lab's Shima Seiki’s knitting machine and language."

Title: FlavorSaver
Description: "Designed and co-developed a mobile recipe experience to inspire users with new meal ideas. Prioritized clarity and ease of use, especially for busy hands in the kitchen."

Title: Yarnivores Branding
Description: "As Design Chair of CMU’s crochet and knitting club, created a playful brand identity mixing yarn and carnivores. Designed illustrations that were printed as sticker sheets and adapted for digital use across social media.

Title: ImpactCMU
Description: "Led design and dev of a promotional site for a university social good project showcase. Focused on both increasing project submissions and boosting student and alumni attendees."

Title: Reflective Tunnel | Lunar Gala: Liminal
Description: "Led the design and construction of a mirrored runway tunnel for a student fashion show. Created an immersive audience experience by blending reflection, light, and motion with the show’s visual identity."

Title: Amigurumi Scavenger Hunt
Description: "Crocheted tiny creatures with CMU’s Yarnivores club and hid them around campus during finals to bring surprise and play into a stressful week"

Title: Inflatable Bunnies | Lunar Gala: Morii
Description: "Led the creation of a 12-foot inflatable bunny sculptures for a fashion show runway. Prototyped in clay, scaled digitally, and fabricated with large-scale textiles to excite attendees as they entered the fashion show."

Title: Adulting 101
Tags: "Full-stack Dev, Persuasive Design, Swift/Academic Research, Collaborative"
Description: "Contributed to a research project with CMU’s Connected Experience Lab, exploring how embedded design can support “adulting” skills. Helped design and develop key features for a game-based prototype and assisted with research to test the effectiveness of persuasive design techniques."

Title: Cross Country Connections
Description: "Co-created an interactive installation connecting users in Pittsburgh and San Francisco through light and touch. Used networked buttons and LEDs to explore how tactile play can build long-distance emotional connection."
Awards: Awarded Meeting of the Minds: Award for Artistic Excellence

Title: Duquesne Incline Microsite
Description: "Developed an informational microsite highlighting a Pittsburgh landmark. Used vertical navigation to playfully mirror to the motion of the real incline."

Title: Acrylic Pour Project
Description: "Co-created a custom, Arduino-powered tool to enable a woman with cerebral palsy create acrylic pour paintings and independently enjoy her hobby."

Title: Sentence Mosaics
Description: "Contributed to a sentence-building game inspired by speech therapy methods. Made the interface responsive to tablets and phones with touch-friendly interactions."

Title: Trash Weaving
Description: "Created a weaving with leftover dorm trash bags into a woven seat with help from roommates"

Title: Embroidered Water Lilies
Description: "Embroided a piece inspired by Van Gogh's Water Lilies with thread and beads."
"Reimagined and developed my brother’s favorite card game as a mobile app. Incorporated a solver feature to make the most of being digital."
